# Leonardo Ramos Agudelo

> Colombian executive based in Mexico City for 8+ years. Early Clara employee (first Growth hire) and General Manager of Clara for Mexico and Colombia. Writes about business leadership, fintech in LatAm, and building a family with intention. Site is bilingual: Spanish at the root, English under /en/.

- [Negocio](https://leonardoramosagudelo.com/negocio): Clara y su enfoque de crecimiento con P&L
- [Familia](https://leonardoramosagudelo.com/familia): Liderazgo en casa
- [Ideas](https://leonardoramosagudelo.com/ideas): Artículos (próximamente)
- [Contacto](https://leonardoramosagudelo.com/contacto): Prensa, charlas y colaboraciones
